Verification before merge

Head: 590d45dfb62685688f112628abe3df7fa2b13279

Changed runtime boundary: shared logging and diagnostic support redaction helpers.
Production entry points exercised: `redactSensitiveText`, `redactSecrets`, `redactTextForSupport`, and `sanitizeSupportSnapshotValue`.

Behavior proof

Denied scenario: a generated fake AWS secret access key was passed through normal text redaction, JSON field redaction, structured redaction, support text redaction, and inline/split command arguments. The raw generated value did not appear in any serialized output.

Benign controls: data URL payload text stayed unchanged, a full provider token stayed whole-token redacted, and an ordinary commit-hash-shaped identifier stayed visible.

Exact command run locally at the PR head:

`node --import tsx --input-type=module` with an inline probe importing the production helper modules listed above.

Exact output:

```json
{
  "head": "590d45dfb62685688f112628abe3df7fa2b13279",
  "denied": {
    "normal": "aws_secret_access_key = Ab9=Ab…Ab9=\n{\"SecretAccessKey\":\"Ab9=Ab…Ab9=\"}\ncmd --aws-secret-access-key=AbCdAb…AbCd",
    "structured": {
      "awsSecretAccessKey": "Ab9=Ab…Ab9="
    },
    "support": "support <redacted-aws-secret-key>",
    "supportArgs": {
      "programArguments": [
        "cmd",
        "--aws-secret-access-key=<redacted>",
        "--awsSecretAccessKey",
        "<redacted>"
      ]
    }
  },
  "control": {
    "dataUrlPreserved": true,
    "providerTokenWhole": true,
    "commitHashPreserved": true
  }
}
```

Additional verification at the same head:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/logging/redact.test.ts src/logging/redact-token-ordering.test.ts src/logging/diagnostic-support-export.test.ts` passed: 3 files, 166 tests.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- GitHub CI rollup completed with `openclaw/ci-gate` success and no failed or pending check runs.

Live-environment gap: none identified for this helper-only redaction change; no provider, channel, browser, native client, filesystem, subprocess, or network integration is required to exercise the changed sink.

Land the shared redaction-engine and support-bundle coverage after the protected maintainer/security merge path is satisfied.
